input.title: LTSE amends rule on Level 3 circuit breaker trading resumption
input.summary: The Long-Term Stock Exchange filed a rule change with immediate effectiveness to amend Rule 11.280, governing the resumption of trading following a Level 3 market-wide circuit breaker halt. A Level 3 halt represents a full market closure, and changes to resumption procedures are directly relevant to settlement timeframes and market disruption handling at DTCC.
evidence_quotes: Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend Rule 11.280 Concerning the Resumption of Trading Following a Level 3 Market-Wide Circuit Breaker Halt
input.notes: headline_only. Rule change is immediately effective (certainty 2). LTSE is a smaller exchange, so reach is limited to business_line rather than market_wide; the rule concerns Level 3 halts (full market closure) which would affect all US equity settlement at DTCC/NSCC/DTC. No detail on the substance of the amendment is available from the headline alone, lowering confidence.
